content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling digital music online traditionally requires third-party platforms that charge hefty fees. For instance, Gumroad takes a 10% commission on each sale, which can drastically cut into your profits. Using an architecture based on NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, allows you to keep more of your earnings. This is especially crucial for independent artists and creators who rely on every dollar to sustain their work. By utilizing an infrastructure that bypasses conventional payment processors, you gain financial sovereignty and control over your sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling music online without Stripe or PayPal consists of several powerful components. At its core, you can utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital storefront. This setup ensures your site is accessible and fast, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic for processing orders. The actual payments are verified through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This architecture allows for automated delivery of digital products, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly, without the need for manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators across regions where payment solutions like Stripe are unavailable or heavily restricted. It is ideal for musicians, artists, and educators in countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe. These creators can leverage cryptocurrencies to reach a global audience without being limited by traditional payment gateways. By adopting this model, you are not just selling music; you are establishing a direct relationship with your customers, free from the constraints of conventional payment platforms.
Retain 99.5% of your revenue with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack comprises several key components that work in harmony. Start with GitHub Pages for hosting, paired with Google Apps Script for your backend logic. For order storage, you can use Supabase or even Google Sheets, both of which provide a reliable and cost-effective solution. File delivery can be managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Lastly, NOWPayments enables smooth crypto transactions with minimal fees, providing the backbone for your sales. Each element is designed to empower you, ensuring you own everything after deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To launch your digital music store, begin by selecting the hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing. Configure your order storage solution, using Supabase or Google Sheets for tracking sales. Prepare your music files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. With these steps, you can quickly establish a sovereign digital storefront that retains your earnings.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Own your data and infrastructure with zero platform dependence.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can use NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency for your ebook sales. This method bypasses traditional payment platforms, allowing you to retain more revenue.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Leverage a complete sovereign stack that uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, integrated with NOWPayments. This minimizes fees while maximizing your control.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by using the architecture of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without platform fees.
Is it possible to accept multiple cryptocurrencies for my music sales?
Absolutely. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling you to accept a wide range of payments for your music products.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?
Using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your digital products as soon as payment is confirmed via NOWPayments.
